name: Milltina
description: Milltina 原生形态键（brow_up_L、eye_zitome_1_L、mouth_happy_1_L 等），用于 Milltina 脸。视线左右未复制 EKU 的水平反转，需游戏核实；标了 guessed 的映射需要实测。
description_en: Milltina's native shape keys (brow_up_L, eye_zitome_1_L, mouth_happy_1_L, ...), for the Milltina face. The gaze left / right does not copy EKU's horizontal flip and needs checking in game; mappings marked guessed need testing.

channels.name: brow_up_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察单侧整条眉毛上移；近似眉尾上提，会带动眉头。
channels.note_en: Blender: the whole brow on one side moves up; approximates an outer brow raise, the inner brow comes along.

channels.name: brow_up_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察单侧整条眉毛上移；近似眉尾上提，会带动眉头。
channels.note_en: Blender: the whole brow on one side moves up; approximates an outer brow raise, the inner brow comes along.

channels.name: brow_down_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察单侧眉毛整体下压。
channels.note_en: Blender: the brow on one side moves down as a whole.

channels.name: brow_down_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察单侧眉毛整体下压。
channels.note_en: Blender: the brow on one side moves down as a whole.

channels.name: brow_sad_1_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察眉头明显上提、眉尾略下垂。
channels.note_en: Blender: inner brow clearly up, outer brow slightly down.

channels.name: brow_sad_1_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察眉头明显上提、眉尾略下垂。
channels.note_en: Blender: inner brow clearly up, outer brow slightly down.

channels.name: brow_anger_3_L
channels.note: 近似皱眉：Blender 观察眉头下压及怒眉弧度；眉心横向聚拢很小，不是纯合拢。避开带明显折皱的 anger_4/5。
channels.note_en: Approximates a frown: in Blender the inner brow lowers with an angry arch; the brows barely draw together, not a pure pinch. Avoids anger_4/5, which crease visibly.

channels.name: brow_anger_3_R
channels.note: 近似皱眉：Blender 观察眉头下压及怒眉弧度；眉心横向聚拢很小，不是纯合拢。避开带明显折皱的 anger_4/5。
channels.note_en: Approximates a frown: in Blender the inner brow lowers with an angry arch; the brows barely draw together, not a pure pinch. Avoids anger_4/5, which crease visibly.

channels.name: eye_close_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察自然单侧闭眼，权重 0.5 为半闭、1 为闭合；线性响应，不沿用 EKU gamma。
channels.note_en: Blender: natural one-eye close, weight 0.5 half closed, 1 closed; linear response, EKU's gamma not used.

channels.name: eye_close_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察自然单侧闭眼，权重 0.5 为半闭、1 为闭合；线性响应，不沿用 EKU gamma。
channels.note_en: Blender: natural one-eye close, weight 0.5 half closed, 1 closed; linear response, EKU's gamma not used.

channels.name: eye_zitome_1_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧上睑下降、眼裂缩小。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's upper lid lowers, the eye narrows.

channels.name: eye_zitome_1_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧上睑下降、眼裂缩小。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's upper lid lowers, the eye narrows.

channels.name: eye_bikkuri_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧睁大眼；eyeWide 游戏语义在词典中为推测。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's eye opens wide; eyeWide's game meaning is a guess in the dictionary.

channels.name: eye_bikkuri_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧睁大眼；eyeWide 游戏语义在词典中为推测。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's eye opens wide; eyeWide's game meaning is a guess in the dictionary.

channels.name: eye_under_up_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧下眼睑上提；近似笑眼下睑分量，cheekSquint 游戏语义为推测。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's lower lid rises; approximates the lower-lid part of a smiling eye, cheekSquint's game meaning is a guess.

channels.name: eye_under_up_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧下眼睑上提；近似笑眼下睑分量，cheekSquint 游戏语义为推测。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's lower lid rises; approximates the lower-lid part of a smiling eye, cheekSquint's game meaning is a guess.

channels.name: eye_look_up
channels.note: Blender 测量：eye_look_left 虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X)、eye_look_right 移向右侧，与 Shinano 同向；按 Shinano 游戏实测换算（虹膜移向角色左侧 = yaw +1）。须游戏核实。
channels.note_en: Blender measurement: eye_look_left moves the iris to the character's own left (+X), eye_look_right to the right, same as Shinano; converted as measured in game on Shinano (iris to the character's left = yaw +1). Needs checking in game.

channels.name: eye_look_down
channels.note: Blender 测量：eye_look_left 虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X)、eye_look_right 移向右侧，与 Shinano 同向；按 Shinano 游戏实测换算（虹膜移向角色左侧 = yaw +1）。须游戏核实。
channels.note_en: Blender measurement: eye_look_left moves the iris to the character's own left (+X), eye_look_right to the right, same as Shinano; converted as measured in game on Shinano (iris to the character's left = yaw +1). Needs checking in game.

channels.name: eye_look_left
channels.note: Blender 测量：eye_look_left 虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X)、eye_look_right 移向右侧，与 Shinano 同向；按 Shinano 游戏实测换算（虹膜移向角色左侧 = yaw +1）。须游戏核实。
channels.note_en: Blender measurement: eye_look_left moves the iris to the character's own left (+X), eye_look_right to the right, same as Shinano; converted as measured in game on Shinano (iris to the character's left = yaw +1). Needs checking in game.

channels.name: eye_look_right
channels.note: Blender 测量：eye_look_left 虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X)、eye_look_right 移向右侧，与 Shinano 同向；按 Shinano 游戏实测换算（虹膜移向角色左侧 = yaw +1）。须游戏核实。
channels.note_en: Blender measurement: eye_look_left moves the iris to the character's own left (+X), eye_look_right to the right, same as Shinano; converted as measured in game on Shinano (iris to the character's left = yaw +1). Needs checking in game.

channels.name: option_cheek_pout_L
channels.note: Blender 正面和侧面已观察对应侧脸颊外鼓。
channels.note_en: Blender, front and side views: that side's cheek puffs out.

channels.name: option_cheek_pout_R
channels.note: Blender 正面和侧面已观察对应侧脸颊外鼓。
channels.note_en: Blender, front and side views: that side's cheek puffs out.

channels.name: vrc.v_e
channels.note: Blender 已观察张嘴及口腔，当前捏脸状态下张嘴也已测试；先采用线性响应。
channels.note_en: Blender: mouth opening and the mouth interior checked, also tested with the current sculpt values; linear response for now.

channels.name: mouth_u_1
channels.note: Blender 已观察双唇收拢、圆形开口；左右平均到同一个键。
channels.note_en: Blender: both lips draw in to a round opening; left and right averaged into one key.

channels.name: mouth_happy_1_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角上扬；两个笑信号只接到本键，合成上限 1。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's mouth corner rises; both smile signals go to this key only, combined up to 1.

channels.name: mouth_happy_1_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角上扬；两个笑信号只接到本键，合成上限 1。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's mouth corner rises; both smile signals go to this key only, combined up to 1.

channels.name: mouth_sad_1_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角下压。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's mouth corner goes down.

channels.name: mouth_sad_1_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角下压。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's mouth corner goes down.

channels.name: mouth_wide_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角向外移动、嘴宽增加。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's mouth corner moves out, the mouth widens.

channels.name: mouth_wide_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角向外移动、嘴宽增加。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side's mouth corner moves out, the mouth widens.

channels.name: mouth_narrow_L
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴宽缩小；游戏 funnelTogether 语义为推测。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side of the mouth narrows; the game's funnelTogether meaning is a guess.

channels.name: mouth_narrow_R
channels.note: Blender 已观察对应侧嘴宽缩小；游戏 funnelTogether 语义为推测。
channels.note_en: Blender: that side of the mouth narrows; the game's funnelTogether meaning is a guess.

channels.name: option_nose_up
channels.note: 近似皱鼻：Blender 观察鼻部上提，并附带少量口周移动；没有鼻翼皱褶，无法独立左右。
channels.note_en: Approximates a nose wrinkle: in Blender the nose lifts with a little movement around the mouth; no nostril creases, left and right cannot move separately.

channels.name: vrc.v_ch
channels.note: 近似提上唇：Blender 已核对 0.4 权重的上唇上提与露齿；会附带下唇下降和张嘴。左右平均、总输出最高 0.4。
channels.note_en: Approximates an upper-lip raise: checked in Blender at weight 0.4, the upper lip rises and the teeth show; the lower lip drops and the mouth opens with it. Left and right averaged, total output at most 0.4.

channels.name: mouth_H_2_L
channels.note: 近似颊肌收紧：Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角向内收、唇线折角；不形成真实酒窝。
channels.note_en: Approximates a cheek-muscle tightening: in Blender that side's corner pulls in with a fold in the lip line; no real dimple.

channels.name: mouth_H_2_R
channels.note: 近似颊肌收紧：Blender 已观察对应侧嘴角向内收、唇线折角；不形成真实酒窝。
channels.note_en: Approximates a cheek-muscle tightening: in Blender that side's corner pulls in with a fold in the lip line; no real dimple.

channels.name: vrc.v_rr
channels.note: 近似降下唇：Blender 已核对 0.4 权重的下唇下拉及开口；也提上唇，左右平均、总输出最高 0.4。
channels.note_en: Approximates a lower-lip drop: checked in Blender at weight 0.4, the lower lip pulls down and the mouth opens; also raises the upper lip, left and right averaged, total output at most 0.4.

channels.name: mouth_H_1_L
channels.note: 近似抿嘴：Blender 已观察对应侧闭口紧绷和嘴角收紧；不是精确唇面压缩，也不保证抵消张嘴键。
channels.note_en: Approximates a lip press: in Blender that side closes taut and the corner tightens; not an exact lip compression, and not guaranteed to cancel the mouth-open key.

channels.name: mouth_H_1_R
channels.note: 近似抿嘴：Blender 已观察对应侧闭口紧绷和嘴角收紧；不是精确唇面压缩，也不保证抵消张嘴键。
channels.note_en: Approximates a lip press: in Blender that side closes taut and the corner tightens; not an exact lip compression, and not guaranteed to cancel the mouth-open key.

channels.name: mouth_crooked_1_L
channels.note: 近似偏嘴：Blender 已观察对应方向非对称嘴形；主要是口角扭曲和收拢，唇中心横向平移极小，不是纯嘴整体平移。
channels.note_en: Approximates a mouth shift: in Blender an asymmetric mouth toward that side; mostly a twisted, drawn-in corner, the lip centre barely moves sideways, not a pure whole-mouth shift.

channels.name: mouth_crooked_1_R
channels.note: 近似偏嘴：Blender 已观察对应方向非对称嘴形；主要是口角扭曲和收拢，唇中心横向平移极小，不是纯嘴整体平移。
channels.note_en: Approximates a mouth shift: in Blender an asymmetric mouth toward that side; mostly a twisted, drawn-in corner, the lip centre barely moves sideways, not a pure whole-mouth shift.

channels.name: mouth_position_up
channels.note: Blender 已观察嘴整体上移；游戏 mouthMove.up 语义仍为推测。
channels.note_en: Blender: the whole mouth moves up; the game's mouthMove.up meaning is still a guess.

channels.name: mouth_position_down
channels.note: Blender 已观察嘴整体下移。
channels.note_en: Blender: the whole mouth moves down.

channels.name: option_jaw_short
channels.note: 近似颏肌上提：Blender 侧面已观察下巴向上缩短；不形成颏肌皱褶。
channels.note_en: Approximates a chin raise: Blender side view shows the chin shortening upward; no chin creases.

channels.name: option_morph_narrow
channels.note: 近似吸腮：Blender 正侧面已观察脸下部轮廓横向收窄；不形成真实脸颊内凹。
channels.note_en: Approximates sucked-in cheeks: Blender front and side views show the lower face outline narrowing sideways; no real hollow cheek.

channels.name: mouth_position_back
channels.note: 近似内卷：Blender 侧面已观察嘴整体后缩；不是唇缘内卷，上下唇无法独立，取较强输入。
channels.note_en: Approximates rolled-in lips: Blender side view shows the whole mouth pulling back; not a lip roll, the upper and lower lips cannot move separately, the stronger input wins.

channels.name: mouth_calm_2
channels.note: 近似闭唇：Blender 已观察嘴中央收紧、口隙减小；不保证抵消张嘴键。vrc.v_pp 在此模型近乎无变化，故没有使用。
channels.note_en: Approximates closed lips: in Blender the mouth centre tightens and the gap narrows; not guaranteed to cancel the mouth-open key. vrc.v_pp barely changes on this model, so it is not used.
